questions.question: Who was the first President of the United States?
questions.explanation: George Washington was the first President of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797.

questions.question: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Germany in May and Japan in September.

questions.question: Which ancient civilization built the pyramids at Giza?
questions.explanation: The pyramids at Giza were built by the ancient Egyptians as tombs for their pharaohs.

questions.question: Who wrote the 'I Have a Dream' speech?
questions.explanation: Martin Luther King Jr. delivered his famous 'I Have a Dream' speech during the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom on August 28, 1963.

questions.question: Which empire was ruled by Genghis Khan?
questions.explanation: Genghis Khan was the founder and first Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, which became the largest contiguous empire in history after his death.

questions.question: In which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
questions.explanation: The Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989, marking a significant moment in the end of the Cold War.

questions.question: Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
questions.explanation: Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the moon on July 20, 1969, during the Apollo 11 mission.

questions.question: Which war was fought between the North and South in America?
questions.explanation: The American Civil War (1861-1865) was fought between the Northern states (Union) and Southern states (Confederacy).

questions.question: Who was the last Pharaoh of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Cleopatra VII was the last active pharaoh of Ptolemaic Egypt, ruling until her death in 30 BC.

questions.question: In which year did the Titanic sink?
questions.explanation: The RMS Titanic sank on April 15, 1912, after hitting an iceberg during its maiden voyage.

questions.question: Which ancient wonder of the world was located in Alexandria?
questions.explanation: The Lighthouse of Alexandria (Pharos of Alexandria) was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

questions.question: Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
questions.explanation: Michelangelo painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel between 1508 and 1512.

questions.question: Which revolution began in 1789?
questions.explanation: The French Revolution began in 1789 and lasted until 1799, fundamentally changing French society.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?
questions.explanation: Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, receiving the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903.

questions.question: Which city was the capital of the Byzantine Empire?
questions.explanation: Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul) was the capital of the Byzantine Empire for over 1,000 years.

questions.question: In which year did India gain independence?
questions.explanation: India gained independence from British rule on August 15, 1947.

questions.question: Who was known as the 'Iron Lady'?
questions.explanation: Margaret Thatcher, the British Prime Minister from 1979-1990, was known as the 'Iron Lady'.

questions.question: Which ancient Greek city-state was known for its military prowess?
questions.explanation: Sparta was renowned for its military discipline and warrior culture in ancient Greece.

questions.question: Who wrote 'The Communist Manifesto'?
questions.explanation: The Communist Manifesto was written by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, published in 1848.

questions.question: Which emperor built the Colosseum in Rome?
questions.explanation: Emperor Vespasian began construction of the Colosseum around 70-72 AD, completed under his son Titus.

questions.question: In which year did the stock market crash, leading to the Great Depression?
questions.explanation: The stock market crash occurred on October 29, 1929, known as 'Black Tuesday', leading to the Great Depression.

questions.question: Who was the first Emperor of Rome?
questions.explanation: Augustus (originally named Octavian) became the first Roman Emperor in 27 BC.

questions.question: Which treaty ended World War I?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Versailles, signed in 1919, officially ended World War I between Germany and the Allied Powers.

questions.question: Who discovered America in 1492?
questions.explanation: Christopher Columbus reached the Americas on October 12, 1492, during his first voyage across the Atlantic.

questions.question: Which dynasty ruled China for the longest period?
questions.explanation: The Zhou Dynasty ruled China for about 800 years (1046-256 BC), making it the longest-lasting dynasty in Chinese history.
